primaryChecks.text: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to the LORD three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
